note: What an order costs (decision 137): the figurine, then a line per priced option and extra. Placeholder prices until Nishant sets them; PETPOP_PRICE_SGD still overrides the figurine. A price of 0.00 adds no line. Extras are priced by kind (a shell part's kind: collar, bandana, ...); '*' prices any kind not listed, so a new kind of extra needs no code. Options: 'stamps' (any hand-painted spot), 'markings_over' (each marking or pattern layer beyond `free`; 10, the most a design has, so a placeholder that never charges for a breed's own look), 'shape' (a torso shape other than the standard one, per shape id or '*'), 'pose' (a pose not in `free`, per pose id or '*').
